column1: # Custom partition table for the ESP32 seeder example.
# A single large factory app slot is plenty for the full Virtual Terminal +
# own table avoids relying on PlatformIO resolving a built-in one by name.
# Sized for the 16 MB flash of the Waveshare ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8; it also
# fits an 8 MB part with room to spare.
